title: Esther Saves the Jews

questions.question: What did the king give to Esther?
questions.explanation: Esther 8:1 (ESV): "...gave to Queen Esther the house of Haman..."

questions.question: Who did Esther put over the house of Haman?
questions.explanation: Esther 8:2 (ESV): "...And Esther set Mordecai over the house of Haman."

questions.question: What did the king give to Mordecai?
questions.explanation: Esther 8:2 (ESV): "And the king took off his signet ring, which he had taken from Haman, and gave it to Mordecai."

questions.question: Why did Esther fall at the king’s feet weeping?
options: To plead for the revocation of the evil plot of Haman
questions.correctAnswer: To plead for the revocation of the evil plot of Haman
questions.explanation: Esther 8:3 (ESV): "...and implored him with tears to put an end to the evil plot of Haman..."

questions.question: Could the previous edict be revoked?
options: No, an edict written in the name of the king and sealed with his ring cannot be revoked
questions.correctAnswer: No, an edict written in the name of the king and sealed with his ring cannot be revoked
questions.explanation: Esther 8:8 (ESV): "...for an edict written in the name of the king and sealed with the king's ring cannot be revoked."

questions.question: What was the solution to the irrevocable law?
options: Write a new edict allowing Jews to defend themselves
questions.correctAnswer: Write a new edict allowing Jews to defend themselves
questions.explanation: Esther 8:11 (ESV): "saying that the king allowed the Jews... to gather and defend their lives..."

questions.question: In which month were the scribes summoned for the new edict?
questions.explanation: Esther 8:9 (ESV): "The king's scribes were summoned at that time, in the third month, which is the month of Sivan..."

questions.question: What animals were used for the couriers?
options: Horses, royal steeds bred from the royal stud
questions.correctAnswer: Horses, royal steeds bred from the royal stud
questions.explanation: Esther 8:10 (ESV): "...mounted couriers riding on swift horses that were used in the king's service, bred from the royal stud..."

questions.question: How was Mordecai dressed when he went out from the king?
options: In royal robes of blue and white, with a golden crown
questions.correctAnswer: In royal robes of blue and white, with a golden crown
questions.explanation: Esther 8:15 (ESV): "Then Mordecai went out from the presence of the king in royal robes of blue and white, with a great golden crown..."

questions.question: How did the city of Susa respond this time?
options: The city of Susa shouted and rejoiced
questions.correctAnswer: The city of Susa shouted and rejoiced
questions.explanation: Esther 8:15 (ESV): "...And the city of Susa shouted and rejoiced."

questions.question: What metaphors are used for the Jews' feelings?
options: Light and gladness and joy and honor
questions.correctAnswer: Light and gladness and joy and honor
questions.explanation: Esther 8:16 (ESV): "The Jews had light and gladness and joy and honor."

questions.question: What happened among the peoples of the country?
options: Many declared themselves Jews, for fear of the Jews had fallen on them
questions.correctAnswer: Many declared themselves Jews, for fear of the Jews had fallen on them
questions.explanation: Esther 8:17 (ESV): "...And many from the peoples of the country declared themselves Jews, for fear of the Jews had fallen on them."

questions.question: What date was the decree to take effect?
questions.explanation: Esther 8:12 (ESV): "...on one day... on the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, which is the month of Adar."

questions.question: What specific authority were the Jews given against attackers?
options: To destroy, to kill, and to annihilate any armed force... and to plunder their goods
questions.correctAnswer: To destroy, to kill, and to annihilate any armed force... and to plunder their goods
questions.explanation: Esther 8:11 (ESV): "...to destroy, to kill, and to annihilate any armed force... and to plunder their goods."

questions.question: What robe material/color is mentioned for Mordecai besides blue and white?
options: A robe of fine linen and purple
questions.correctAnswer: A robe of fine linen and purple
questions.explanation: Esther 8:15 (ESV): "...and a robe of fine linen and purple."

key_verse_text: The Jews had light and gladness and joy and honor.
